test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some fans are bulbs.

Some bulbs are tube lights.

Some tube lights are coolers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some fans are coolers.

II. Some tube lights are fans.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution: Statements: Some fans are bulbs. Some bulbs are tube lights. Some tube lights are coolers. __Venn diagram:__
